R06.entities: LE01 商机管理、LE02 项目月度销售预测、LE05 客户、LE07 订单、LE08 订单产品、LE10 团队、LE11 团队人员关系、LE16 发货单、LE17 发货单明细、LE18 产品物料

R07.name: 预计出货量达成率
R07.definition: R06 预计出货量 ÷ B03 目标出货量。
R07.rule: < 1 判定全年出货量预计不达成（BR-A02）。
R07.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH requested AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
  ), bounds AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
      MAX(end_at) AS end_at
    FROM requested
  ), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
  ), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
      CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
  ), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      t.team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
    JOIN __teams AS t
      ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
    FROM __owner_team_candidates
    GROUP BY
      owner_id
  ), __remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid,
      ownerid,
      new_salesbg,
      new_accproducttype,
      new_accountlevel,
      parentaccountid,
      new_cellcapacity,
      new_cell_qty
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
  ), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),
      CAST(ownerid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      CAST(parentaccountid AS TEXT)
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source
  ), __shipment_items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
      CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CAST(s.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT)), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(s.new_salesorderid AS TEXT)), '')
      ) AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s
      ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      i.new_qty > 0
      AND s.statecode = 0
      AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL
      AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
          AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
        )
      )
  ), __selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      order_id
    FROM __shipment_items
    WHERE
      order_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __direct_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') AS opportunity_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      opportunity_id
    FROM __direct_order_links
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __direct_order_links AS d
        WHERE
          d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.order_id,
      link.opportunity_id,
      o.ownerid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      teams.team_name
    FROM __order_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
        THEN MIN(ownerid)
      END AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
        THEN MIN(team_name)
      END AS team_name
    FROM __order_dimension_candidates
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
        THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
      END AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
    WHERE
      p.new_system_energy > 0
      AND EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __shipment_items AS i
        WHERE
          i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
      )
    GROUP BY
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
  ), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.fact_id,
      i.fact_date,
      i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      (
        i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
      ) AS invalid,
      d.d002,
      d.d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      d.team_name AS d004
    FROM __shipment_items AS i
    JOIN __product_energy AS p
      ON p.product_code = i.product_code
    LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
      ON d.order_id = i.order_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = i.account_id
  ), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
        t.new_year,
        CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
        CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
        CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
        t.new_month1_power,
        t.new_month2_power,
        t.new_month3_power,
        t.new_month4_power,
        t.new_month5_power,
        t.new_month6_power,
        t.new_month7_power,
        t.new_month8_power,
        t.new_month9_power,
        t.new_month10_power,
        t.new_month11_power,
        t.new_month12_power,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
          ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.rn = 1
  ), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  ), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
        THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END AS fact_date,
      CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      FALSE AS invalid,
      t.d002,
      COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
            THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
          END
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
        WHERE
          CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
      ) AS d004
    FROM __target_latest AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1_power),
        (2, t.new_month2_power),
        (3, t.new_month3_power),
        (4, t.new_month4_power),
        (5, t.new_month5_power),
        (6, t.new_month6_power),
        (7, t.new_month7_power),
        (8, t.new_month8_power),
        (9, t.new_month9_power),
        (10, t.new_month10_power),
        (11, t.new_month11_power),
        (12, t.new_month12_power)
    ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
      ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = t.account_id
    WHERE
      t.target_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
          AND CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END < CASE
            WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
          END
        )
      )
  ), __forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.fact_id,
      ranked.opportunity_id,
      ranked.fact_date,
      ranked.qty,
      ranked.energy_kwh
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
        CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST(m.new_shipforecast_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
        CAST(m.new_singlepower AS DECIMAL) AS energy_kwh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
          ORDER BY CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" AS m
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          b.start_at IS NULL
          OR (
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
          )
        )
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn = 1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
      END AS product_type,
      CAST(o.new_cellcapacity AS DECIMAL) AS cell_energy_kwh,
      CAST(o.new_cell_qty AS DECIMAL) AS cells_per_set
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source AS o
    WHERE
      EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __forecast_rows AS f
        WHERE
          f.opportunity_id = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(product_type)
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)
        AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh) > 0
        THEN CASE
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = '电芯'
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = 'PACK'
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set) = 1
          AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cells_per_set)
          AND MIN(cells_per_set) > 0
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh) * MIN(cells_per_set)
        END
      END AS alternative_unit_kwh
    FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values
    GROUP BY
      opportunity_id
  ), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      f.fact_id,
      f.opportunity_id,
      f.fact_date,
      f.qty,
      CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh > 0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh
    FROM __forecast_rows AS f
    LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS e
      ON e.opportunity_id = f.opportunity_id
  ), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('FORECAST' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      f.fact_id,
      f.fact_date,
      CASE
        WHEN f.qty = 0
        THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
        WHEN f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh > 0
        THEN f.qty * f.unit_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)
      END AS value_gwh,
      (
        f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty < 0 OR (
          f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL
        )
      ) AS invalid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      teams.team_name AS d004
    FROM __remaining_converted AS f
    JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = f.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_teams AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __actual_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __target_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __forecast_facts
  ), checked AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
    FROM facts AS f
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
    FROM checked AS f
    WHERE
      f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
  ), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
          BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL'),
          FALSE
        )
        THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS actual_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'FORECAST'
        AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND f.copies = 1
        AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid, TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh
    FROM scoped AS f
  )
  SELECT
    (
      a.actual_gwh + COALESCE(a.remaining_gwh, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL))
    ) / NULLIF(a.target_gwh, 0) AS "YWLN_M0012"
  FROM aggregated AS a
) AS __x360_period_result

-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (

 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at

  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp),CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 

), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (

 SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request

)

SELECT __x360_period_result.* FROM (

WITH requested AS (SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT start_at,end_at FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds ),
bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested),
__accounts AS MATERIALIZED (

 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT teamid::text,name::text AS team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm
 JOIN __teams t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid::text
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(t.team_name),'') IS NOT NULL
), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT owner_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name)=1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
 FROM __owner_team_candidates GROUP BY owner_id
),
__remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT opportunityid,ownerid,new_salesbg,new_accproducttype,new_accountlevel,parentaccountid,

        new_cellcapacity,new_cell_qty

 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"

),

__opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT opportunityid::text,ownerid::text,new_salesbg::text AS d002,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
   WHEN new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
   WHEN new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
  new_accountlevel::text AS d005,parentaccountid::text
 FROM __remaining_opportunity_source
),
__forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT ranked.fact_id,ranked.opportunity_id,ranked.fact_date,ranked.qty,ranked.energy_kwh

 FROM (

  SELECT m.new_oppmonthid::text AS fact_id,m.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,

   m.new_accountdate::timestamp AS fact_date,

   m.new_shipforecast_qty::numeric AS qty,m.new_singlepower::numeric AS energy_kwh,

   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

    PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id::text,date_trunc('month',m.new_accountdate::timestamp)

    ORDER BY m.new_accountdate::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,m.createdon::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,

             m.modifiedon::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,m.new_oppmonthid::text DESC NULLS LAST

   ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn

  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" m CROSS JOIN bounds b

  WHERE NULLIF(btrim(m.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL

   AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL

   AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR

    (m.new_accountdate::timestamp>=b.start_at AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp<b.end_at))

 ) ranked

 WHERE ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn=1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL

), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT DISTINCT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,

  CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'

       WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' END AS product_type,

  o.new_cellcapacity::numeric AS cell_energy_kwh,o.new_cell_qty::numeric AS cells_per_set

 FROM __remaining_opportunity_source o

 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __forecast_rows f WHERE f.opportunity_id=o.opportunityid::text)

), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT opportunity_id,

  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(product_type)

         AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)

         AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh)>0 THEN

   CASE WHEN MIN(product_type)='电芯' THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)

        WHEN MIN(product_type)='PACK'

         AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(cells_per_set)

         AND MIN(cells_per_set)>0 THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)*MIN(cells_per_set) END

  END AS alternative_unit_kwh

 FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values GROUP BY opportunity_id

), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT f.fact_id,f.opportunity_id,f.fact_date,f.qty,

  CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh>0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh

 FROM __forecast_rows f

 LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type e ON e.opportunity_id=f.opportunity_id

), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT DISTINCT 'FORECAST'::text AS kind,f.fact_id,f.fact_date,

  CASE WHEN f.qty=0 THEN 0::numeric

       WHEN f.qty>0 AND f.unit_kwh>0 THEN f.qty*f.unit_kwh/1000000::numeric END AS value_gwh,

  (f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty<0 OR (f.qty>0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL)) AS invalid,

  o.d002,o.d003,o.d005,c.customer_name AS d006,teams.team_name AS d004

 FROM __remaining_converted f

 JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=f.opportunity_id

 LEFT JOIN __accounts c ON c.accountid=o.parentaccountid

 LEFT JOIN __owner_teams teams ON teams.owner_id=o.ownerid

),

facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM __forecast_facts
),
checked AS (SELECT f.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,fact_id) AS copies FROM facts f),
scoped AS (SELECT f.*,to_char(f.fact_date,'YYYY-MM') AS month_key FROM checked f WHERE f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (SELECT SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE kind='FORECAST' AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL AND f.copies=1 AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid,TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh FROM scoped f)
SELECT a.remaining_gwh AS "YWLN_M0010" FROM aggregated a
) AS __x360_period_result

 ) THEN 'order_change'

 WHEN so.statecode=0 THEN 'normal_order' END AS status_code, CASE WHEN ((so.order_amount_rmb_ex_tax)::text)::text ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN ((so.order_amount_rmb_ex_tax)::text)::numeric END AS amount_yuan

 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a ON a.accountid=so.customerid
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.new_salesordertype::text='1' AND so.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3')
  AND so.statecode=0 AND so.new_ord_oa_state::text='5'
  AND so.createdon::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.createdon::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
  AND ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR so.createdon::timestamp>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds))
  AND ((SELECT end_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR so.createdon::timestamp<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds))
  AND NOT COALESCE(TRUE AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters),FALSE)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 cx WHERE cx.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND cx.salesorderid<>so.salesorderid
   AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
), fulfillment_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY order_id) AS source_copies FROM fulfillment_orders_distinct f
), fulfillment_shipments_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS shipment_item_id,s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,i.new_amount::numeric AS amount_yuan
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i ON i.new_ord_shipment_id=s.new_ord_shipmentid AND i.new_qty>0
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
  AND ((SELECT end_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fulfillment_orders_distinct o WHERE o.order_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
), fulfillment_shipments AS (
 SELECT f.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY shipment_item_id) AS source_copies FROM fulfillment_shipments_distinct f
), fulfillment_shipped_by_order AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_yuan) AS amount_yuan,BOOL_OR(amount_yuan IS NULL OR shipment_item_id IS NULL OR source_copies>1) AS invalid
 FROM fulfillment_shipments GROUP BY order_id
)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.order_id AS fact_id,f.fact_date,
 COALESCE(s.amount_yuan,0)/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,
 (f.source_copies>1 OR COALESCE(s.invalid,FALSE)) AS invalid,FALSE AS poison_time,
 f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,NULL::text AS status_code,NULL::text AS helmet_status
FROM fulfillment_orders f LEFT JOIN fulfillment_shipped_by_order s ON s.order_id=f.order_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'm1'::text AS measure_tag,f.order_id AS fact_id,f.fact_date,
 f.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,
 (f.source_copies>1 OR f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS invalid,FALSE AS poison_time,
 f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,NULL::text AS status_code,NULL::text AS helmet_status
FROM fulfillment_orders f
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
)
SELECT ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END))/NULLIF(((CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m1'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m1') END)),0) AS "YWLN_M0037" FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()
) AS __x360_gov_result

O04.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at),
__x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT __sign_line.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunityid
 FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb __sign_line
 JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb __sign_order
   ON __sign_order.salesorderid=__sign_line.salesorderid
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
   AND NULLIF(btrim(__sign_line.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
   AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
),
 __x360_gov_source_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."project_name",__x360_raw."input_time",__x360_raw."energy_mwh",__x360_raw."is_awarded",__x360_raw."winner_announce_time",__x360_raw."remark",__x360_raw."seq_no" AS "bid_record_id",__x360_raw."bid_amount" AS "bid_amount" FROM ded_public."p_fm_bid_project_info" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH __audit_signed_0e1c9f223bec_cancelled AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT cx.new_salesorderid AS order_id
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" cx
 WHERE cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
 ),
__audit_signed_0e1c9f223bec_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT sx.opportunityid
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" sx WHERE sx.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(sx.salesorderid IN (SELECT order_id FROM __audit_signed_0e1c9f223bec_cancelled),FALSE)
),
__helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
 AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
 max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
 max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
 AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at, NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp), CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 
),
bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at, MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested),
board_flt_product_lines AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS v WHERE FALSE
),
board_flt_product_types AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS v WHERE FALSE
),
board_flt_team_ids AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS v WHERE FALSE
),
board_flt_customer_levels AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS v WHERE FALSE
),
board_flt_customer_ids AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS v WHERE FALSE
),
board_flt_status_codes AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS v WHERE FALSE
),
board_flt_order_states AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS v WHERE FALSE
)
SELECT l."YWLN_M0142", r."YWLN_M_ORDER_CANCEL_CHANGE"
FROM (
WITH measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_mwh)::numeric/1000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR (f.energy_mwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status FROM (
WITH opportunity_link_summary AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT name::text AS linked_project_name,COUNT(DISTINCT opportunityid) AS matches,MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunity_id FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" WHERE opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name::text), ranked AS (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_time::timestamp DESC,bid_record_id DESC) AS rn
 FROM __x360_gov_source_1 b WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name ~ '[^[:space:]]'
 AND bid_record_id IS NOT NULL AND input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND input_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
), linked AS (
 SELECT b.*,COALESCE(mx.matches,0) AS matches,mx.opportunity_id FROM ranked b
 LEFT JOIN opportunity_link_summary mx ON mx.linked_project_name=b.project_name::text
 WHERE b.rn=1
)
 SELECT DISTINCT b.bid_record_id::text AS fact_id,b.input_time::timestamp AS fact_date,b.input_time::timestamp,b.winner_announce_time::timestamp,
 b.energy_mwh,CASE WHEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount') ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount')::numeric END AS amount_yuan,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_o.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN (TRUE) AND b.input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.input_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
 AND (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL OR (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp>=b.input_time::timestamp AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-b.input_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-b.input_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-b.input_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.winner_announce_time::date-b.input_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.winner_announce_time::date-b.input_time::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM __helmet_cfg p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D022') AS helmet_status,
 FALSE AS source_issue,b.matches AS opportunity_matches,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 __sign_match WHERE __sign_match.opportunityid=o.opportunityid::text) AS has_signed,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') LIKE '%弃标%') AS abandoned,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AND b.is_awarded IN ('是','1')) AS won,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AND b.is_awarded IN ('否','0')) AS lost,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL OR b.winner_announce_time::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))) AS in_progress
 FROM linked b LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_o ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid ON o.opportunityid=b.opportunity_id AND b.matches=1
) f WHERE f.energy_mwh>0 AND f.won AND f.opportunity_matches=1 AND NOT f.has_signed
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_flt_product_lines) OR CAST(f.d002 AS text) IN (SELECT v FROM board_flt_product_lines)) 
 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_flt_product_types) OR CAST(f.d003 AS text) IN (SELECT v FROM board_flt_product_types)) 
 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_flt_team_ids) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND tm."teamid"::text IN (SELECT v FROM board_flt_team_ids)))) 
 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_flt_customer_levels) OR CAST(f.d005 AS text) IN (SELECT v FROM board_flt_customer_levels)) 
 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_flt_customer_ids) OR CAST(f.d006 AS text) IN (SELECT v FROM board_flt_customer_ids)) 
 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_flt_status_codes) OR CAST(f.helmet_status AS text) IN (SELECT v FROM board_flt_status_codes)) 
)
SELECT (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0142" FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()
) l
CROSS JOIN (
WITH __x360_gov_source_11 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."salesorderid",__x360_raw."new_changetype",__x360_raw."new_changestatus",__x360_raw."new_salesordertype",__x360_raw."new_order_category",__x360_raw."new_ord_oa_state",__x360_raw."new_salesorderid",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."name",__x360_raw."ordernumber",__x360_raw."opportunityid",__x360_raw."customerid",__x360_raw."statecode",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_customeridname",__x360_raw."new_prod_type",__x360_raw."new_dept_idname",__x360_raw."new_approval_time",__x360_raw."new_amount" AS "order_amount_rmb_ex_tax" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH __order_detail_period AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT start_at,end_at FROM bounds 
), __order_detail_cancelled AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid,new_salesorderid,new_changetype,new_changestatus,new_approval_time
 FROM __x360_gov_source_11
 WHERE TRUE AND TRUE
   AND new_changestatus='8' AND new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
), __order_detail_reduced_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid,salesorderdetailid,quantity,new_changepostqty,new_effectivedate,new_expirydate
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb"
 WHERE salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0
   AND TRUE AND TRUE
   AND (new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR new_effectivedate::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
   AND (new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR new_expirydate::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
),
__order_detail_ywln_d002 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT v FROM board_flt_product_lines 
),
__order_detail_ywln_d003 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT v FROM board_flt_product_types 
),
__order_detail_ywln_d004 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT v FROM board_flt_team_ids
 UNION SELECT t.name::text FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t
 JOIN board_flt_team_ids b ON t.teamid::text=b.v 
),
__order_detail_ywln_d005 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CASE v
 WHEN '核心大客户' THEN '0' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '1' WHEN '战略客户' THEN '1'
 WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '2' WHEN '重要客户' THEN '2' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '3'
 WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN '4' WHEN 'BG客户' THEN '4' ELSE v END FROM board_flt_customer_levels 
),
__order_detail_ywln_d006 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),''),b.v)
 FROM board_flt_customer_ids b LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a ON a.accountid::text=b.v 
),
__order_detail_ywln_d016 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CASE v WHEN '正常订单' THEN 'normal_order'
 WHEN '订单变更' THEN 'order_change' WHEN '已变更订单' THEN 'order_change'
 WHEN '订单取消' THEN 'order_cancel' WHEN '已取消订单' THEN 'order_cancel' ELSE v END FROM board_flt_order_states 
),
__order_detail_ywln_d049 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
  WHERE FALSE 
),
__order_customer_levels AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name,
        MIN(a.new_accountlevel)::text AS customer_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')
), __shared_order_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid AS fact_id,NULLIF(btrim(so.ordernumber::text),'') AS d049,so.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN btrim(so.new_prod_type::text) IN ('100000000','100000001','100000004','100000005','100000006','100000013') THEN '电芯'
      WHEN btrim(so.new_prod_type::text)='100000002' THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 NULLIF(btrim(so.new_dept_idname::text),'') AS order_team,cl.customer_level AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'') AS d006,
 CASE WHEN so.statecode=2 THEN 'order_cancel' WHEN so.statecode=0 AND so.new_changestatus='8' THEN 'order_change' WHEN so.statecode=0 THEN 'normal_order' END AS status_code, CASE WHEN ((to_jsonb(so."order_amount_rmb_ex_tax")#>>'{}'))::text ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN ((to_jsonb(so."order_amount_rmb_ex_tax")#>>'{}'))::numeric END AS amount_yuan
 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 so
 LEFT JOIN __order_customer_levels cl ON cl.customer_name=NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'')
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
),
__shared_order_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies FROM __shared_order_distinct
),
__order_energy AS (
WITH orders AS (SELECT * FROM __shared_order_headers)
, fact_distinct AS (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(l.salesorderdetailid,'MISSING_LINE:'||r.fact_id) AS fact_id,r.fact_date,r.status_code,
 r.d002,r.d003,r.order_team,r.d005,r.d006,r.d049,CASE WHEN (so.statecode=0 AND NOT COALESCE((so.statecode=2 OR
      (so.new_changetype='4' AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_cancelled cx
        WHERE cx.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND cx.salesorderid<>so.salesorderid
          AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))),FALSE)) AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_changetype IN ('1','3','6','8') AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AND l.quantity>0 AND l.new_changepostqty>=0 AND l.new_changepostqty<l.quantity AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) THEN energy_calc.base_energy_kwh*l.new_changepostqty/NULLIF(l.quantity,0) ELSE energy_calc.base_energy_kwh END AS metric_value,r.copies AS source_copies
 FROM orders r JOIN __x360_gov_source_11 so ON so.salesorderid=r.fact_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l ON l.salesorderid=r.fact_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" pr ON pr.productid=l.new_product_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE
   WHEN l.quantity IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
   WHEN pr.new_system_energy>0 THEN l.quantity*pr.new_system_energy
   WHEN pr.new_voltage>0 AND pr.new_capacity>0
    THEN l.quantity*pr.new_voltage*pr.new_capacity/1000::numeric
   ELSE NULL::numeric
  END AS base_energy_kwh
 ) energy_calc
 WHERE r.status_code IN ('normal_order','order_change','order_cancel') AND so.new_ord_oa_state='5' AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))), metric_facts AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS metric_copies FROM fact_distinct)
, scoped AS (SELECT f.*,f.order_team AS d004 FROM metric_facts f WHERE 1=1
  AND ((SELECT start_at FROM __order_detail_period) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=CAST((SELECT start_at FROM __order_detail_period) AS timestamp) AND f.fact_date<CAST((SELECT end_at FROM __order_detail_period) AS timestamp))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d002 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d002))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d003 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d003))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d004 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.order_team IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d004))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d005 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d005))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d006 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d006)))

 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)

(WITH requested AS (

S03.name: 未发货电量
S03.definition: 有效订单下尚未发货的电量（订未发电量）。
S03.rule: 剩余目标订单覆盖率（电量）的分子（C09）。
S03.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __repl_product AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r."new_capacity",(r."new_capacity"::numeric/1000::numeric) AS "new_electricquantity",r."new_system_energy",r."productid",r."productnumber",r."statecode" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" r)
SELECT __repl_result.* FROM (
WITH shared_bounds AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at, NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp), CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 
),
active_shipments AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (s.new_ord_shipmentid||'') AS new_ord_shipmentid,s.new_product_id,s.new_totalqty,s.new_money::numeric AS amount_yuan
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s CROSS JOIN shared_bounds b
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0
   AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
   AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR (s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp>=b.start_at AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<b.end_at))
), product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (productid||'') AS productid,new_electricquantity ,"productnumber","new_system_energy" FROM __repl_product
), shipment_measures AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,s.new_ord_shipmentid AS fact_id,
   (s.new_totalqty*p.new_electricquantity)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS energy_value,
   s.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS amount_value,
   (COALESCE(s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0,FALSE)
      OR (s.new_totalqty*p.new_electricquantity) IS NULL) AS energy_invalid,
   (s.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS amount_invalid,TRUE AS energy_covered
 FROM active_shipments s LEFT JOIN product_energy p ON p.productid=s.new_product_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'm1'::text AS measure_tag,COALESCE(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text,'MISSING_LINE:'||s.new_ord_shipmentid) AS fact_id,
   (i.new_qty*__actual_energy.new_system_energy)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS energy_value,
   i.new_amount::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_value,
   (COALESCE(__actual_energy.new_system_energy IS NULL OR __actual_energy.new_system_energy<=0,FALSE)
     OR i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NULL OR (i.new_qty*__actual_energy.new_system_energy) IS NULL) AS energy_invalid,
   (COALESCE(p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0,FALSE) OR i.new_amount IS NULL) AS amount_invalid,(__actual_energy.new_system_energy>0) AS energy_covered
 FROM active_shipments s
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i ON i.new_ord_shipment_id=s.new_ord_shipmentid AND i.new_qty>0
 LEFT JOIN product_energy p ON p.productid=i.new_product_id
 LEFT JOIN product_energy __actual_energy ON __actual_energy.productnumber=i.new_productcode AND __actual_energy.new_system_energy>0
), shipment_checked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM shipment_measures
)
SELECT
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_and(energy_covered IS TRUE) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1'),FALSE) THEN
 (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(energy_invalid OR fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(energy_value) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m0') END)
 -(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(energy_invalid OR fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1' AND energy_covered),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(energy_value) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1' AND energy_covered) END) ELSE NULL END AS "YWLN_M0145",
 (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(amount_invalid OR fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_value) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m0') END)
 -(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(amount_invalid OR fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_value) FILTER(WHERE measure_tag='m1') END) AS "YWLN_M0149"
FROM shipment_checked
) __repl_result

S05.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。

WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_card_pending_filter(v) AS (

 SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE

), __x360_card_pie_filter(v) AS (

 SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE

),

__requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp),CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 
),
__bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __requested),
__flt_YWLN_D002(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D003(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D004(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D005(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D006(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D045(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__order_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,
 so.customerid::text AS customerid,NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'') AS customer_name,so.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,
 so.ownerid::text AS ownerid,so.new_amount::numeric AS order_amount,so.createdon::timestamp AS createdon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so CROSS JOIN __bounds b
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.statecode=0 AND so.createdon::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
 AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR (so.createdon::timestamp>=b.start_at AND so.createdon::timestamp<b.end_at))
),
__orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,MIN(order_no) AS order_no,MIN(customerid) AS customerid,MIN(customer_name) AS customer_name,
 MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunityid,MIN(ownerid) AS ownerid,MIN(order_amount) AS order_amount,
 COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue FROM __order_raw GROUP BY salesorderid
),

 FROM __actual_eligible i LEFT JOIN __line_latest l ON l.salesorderid=i.order_id
 AND l.lineitemnumber::numeric=i.normalized_seq
 AND (l.new_product_id=i.product_id OR NULLIF(btrim(i.product_code),'')=NULLIF(btrim(l.product_code),''))
 GROUP BY i.item_id
),
__actual_linked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,m.line_matches,m.line_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'')=NULLIF(btrim(m.line_uom_id),''),FALSE) AS same_uom
 FROM __actual_eligible i JOIN __actual_matches m ON m.item_id=i.item_id
),
__actual_problem_rows AS (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 WHEN line_matches<>1 THEN '发货明细无法唯一关联订单行'
 WHEN NOT same_uom THEN '发货与订单计量单位不一致或缺失'
 WHEN shipped_qty IS NULL THEN '实际发货数量缺失' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_linked
 WHERE version_issue OR header_version_issue OR line_matches<>1 OR NOT same_uom OR shipped_qty IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN matched_header_id IS NULL THEN '发货明细找不到可用发货主表'
 WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 ELSE '有效发货单缺实际发货时间' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND
 (matched_header_id IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR (header_state=0 AND shipped_at IS NULL))
),
__actual_bad_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,string_agg(DISTINCT reason,'、' ORDER BY reason) AS reason
 FROM __actual_problem_rows GROUP BY order_id
),
__actual_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,SUM(shipped_qty) AS net_shipped_qty,
 BOOL_OR(shipped_qty IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR NOT same_uom) AS source_issue
 FROM __actual_linked WHERE line_matches=1 GROUP BY line_id
),
__line_balances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.quantity AS ordered_qty,
 COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0) AS net_shipped_qty,b.reason AS actual_problem,
 l.source_issue OR COALESCE(s.source_issue,FALSE) OR b.order_id IS NOT NULL
 OR l.quantity IS NULL OR l.quantity<0 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)<0
 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)>l.quantity AS quantity_issue
 FROM __active_lines l LEFT JOIN __actual_by_line s ON s.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __actual_bad_orders b ON b.order_id=l.salesorderid
),
__pending_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty END AS pending_qty,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE net_shipped_qty END AS net_shipped_qty,
 quantity_issue,actual_problem,FALSE AS energy_product_issue,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue OR ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty>0 THEN 1::bigint END AS plan_rows
 FROM __line_balances
),
__product_raw AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT DISTINCT p.productid::text AS productid,

 CASE WHEN p.new_system_energy>0 THEN p.new_system_energy::numeric

      WHEN p.new_voltage>0 AND p.new_capacity>0 THEN p.new_voltage::numeric*p.new_capacity::numeric/1000::numeric

 END AS unit_energy_kwh

 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" p

 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __active_lines l WHERE l.new_product_id=p.productid::text)

), __product_energy AS (

 SELECT productid,MIN(unit_energy_kwh) AS unit_energy_kwh,

 COUNT(*)>1 OR BOOL_OR(unit_energy_kwh IS NULL OR unit_energy_kwh<=0) AS source_issue

 FROM __product_raw GROUP BY productid

),

__opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
 WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_risklevel::text AS risk_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
),
__accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name,
 MIN(a.new_accountlevel)::text AS customer_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')
),
__team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.teamid::text AS team_id,t.name::text AS team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid
),
__owner_teams AS (
 SELECT owner_id,string_agg(DISTINCT team_name,'、' ORDER BY team_name) AS team_names FROM __team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
__line_base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.salesorderid AS order_id,l.new_product_id AS product_id,
 l.quantity AS ordered_qty,l.requestdeliveryby AS due_at,l.requestdeliveryby::date AS due_date,l.source_issue AS line_issue,
 so.order_no,so.customerid,so.order_amount,so.source_issue AS order_issue,ot.total_quantity,ot.quantity_issue AS order_quantity_issue,
 o.d002,o.d003,a.customer_level AS d005,COALESCE(o.owner_id,so.ownerid) AS owner_id,so.customer_name AS d006,CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.d005 IN ('0','1','2') OR o.risk_level IN ('1','2'),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,p.pending_qty,p.net_shipped_qty,p.actual_problem,p.quantity_issue AS pending_quantity_issue,p.plan_rows,pr.unit_energy_kwh,(pr.productid IS NULL OR pr.source_issue) AS product_issue
 FROM __active_lines l JOIN __orders so ON so.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 JOIN __order_totals ot ON ot.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __pending_by_line p ON p.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __product_energy pr ON pr.productid=l.new_product_id
 LEFT JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.new_opportunity_id),''),ot.unique_opportunityid,NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid),''))
 LEFT JOIN __accounts a ON a.customer_name=so.customer_name
),
__line_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,team.team_names AS d004,
 CASE WHEN due_at<(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN due_at>=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) THEN 'normal_pending' END AS status_code,
 (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-due_date AS overdue_days,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND order_amount IS NOT NULL AND ordered_qty>=0 AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*ordered_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS allocated_order_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND pending_qty>0 AND ordered_qty>0 AND pending_qty<=ordered_qty AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*pending_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS pending_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND NOT product_issue
 AND pending_qty>0 AND (ordered_qty IS NULL OR pending_qty<=ordered_qty)
 THEN pending_qty*unit_energy_kwh END AS pending_energy_kwh
 FROM __line_base f LEFT JOIN __owner_teams team ON team.owner_id=f.owner_id
),
__line_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.* FROM __line_facts f WHERE TRUE
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D002) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D002)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D003) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D003)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __team_members tm WHERE tm.owner_id=f.owner_id AND (tm.team_name IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR tm.team_id IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004)))))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR CASE f.d005 WHEN '0' THEN '核心大客户' WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR f.customerid IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D045) OR (f.anomaly_flag IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D045)))
),
__pending_scope AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT f.* FROM __line_scope f WHERE f.plan_rows IS NOT NULL

 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pending_filter)

      OR f.status_code IS NULL OR f.status_code IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pending_filter))

 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pie_filter)

      OR CASE f.status_code WHEN 'overdue_pending' THEN '超期订未发' WHEN 'normal_pending' THEN '正常订未发' END

         IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pie_filter))

),

__totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code IS NULL) AS missing_due_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS overdue_amount_valid_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS normal_amount_valid_rows,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_amount,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_amount,
 SUM(pending_energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_energy
 FROM __pending_scope
),
__denominator AS (
 SELECT SUM(allocated_order_amount) FILTER(WHERE allocated_order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND (plan_rows IS NULL OR (pending_amount IS NOT NULL AND status_code IS NOT NULL))) AS order_amount
 FROM __line_scope
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.overdue_energy/1000000::numeric END AS "M0134",

CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.overdue_amount/100000000::numeric END AS "YWLN_M0143"
FROM __totals t CROSS JOIN __denominator d

S06.name: 超期订未发电量
S06.definition: 承诺交期早于统计截止日仍未发货的电量。
S06.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_card_pending_filter(v) AS (

 SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE

), __x360_card_pie_filter(v) AS (

 SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE

),

__requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp),CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 
),
__bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __requested),
__flt_YWLN_D002(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D003(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D004(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D005(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D006(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__flt_YWLN_D045(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
),
__order_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,
 so.customerid::text AS customerid,NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'') AS customer_name,so.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,
 so.ownerid::text AS ownerid,so.new_amount::numeric AS order_amount,so.createdon::timestamp AS createdon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so CROSS JOIN __bounds b
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.statecode=0 AND so.createdon::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
 AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR (so.createdon::timestamp>=b.start_at AND so.createdon::timestamp<b.end_at))
),
__orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,MIN(order_no) AS order_no,MIN(customerid) AS customerid,MIN(customer_name) AS customer_name,
 MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunityid,MIN(ownerid) AS ownerid,MIN(order_amount) AS order_amount,
 COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue FROM __order_raw GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__line_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderdetailid::text AS salesorderdetailid,l.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,
 l.new_product_id::text AS new_product_id,l.lineitemnumber,l.new_opportunity_id::text AS new_opportunity_id,
 l.quantity::numeric AS quantity,l.new_productnumber::text AS product_code,l.uomid::text AS uom_id,l.requestdeliveryby::timestamp AS requestdeliveryby,
 l.modifiedon::timestamp AS modifiedon,l.new_effectivedate::timestamp AS new_effectivedate FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid::text)
),
__line_ranked AS (
 SELECT l.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY salesorderdetailid ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __line_raw l WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND l.modifiedon<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
),
__line_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderdetailid,MIN(salesorderid) AS salesorderid,MIN(new_product_id) AS new_product_id,
 MIN(lineitemnumber) AS lineitemnumber,MIN(new_opportunity_id) AS new_opportunity_id,
 MIN(quantity) AS quantity,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,MIN(requestdeliveryby) AS requestdeliveryby,
 MIN(new_effectivedate) AS new_effectivedate,COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue
 FROM __line_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY salesorderdetailid
),
__active_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.* FROM __line_latest l WHERE (l.new_effectivedate IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid)
),
__order_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
 BOOL_OR(source_issue OR quantity IS NULL OR quantity<0) OR SUM(quantity)<=0 AS quantity_issue,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),''))=1 THEN MIN(NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),'')) END AS unique_opportunityid
 FROM __active_lines GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__shipment_header_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.new_ord_shipmentid,s.new_shipping2_date,s.statecode,s.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
),
__shipment_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid,i.new_ord_shipment_id,i.new_ord_salesorder_id,i.new_seq,
 i.new_product_id,i.new_productcode,i.new_uom_id,i.new_qty,i.statecode,i.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text)
),
__actual_header_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_header_source
),
__actual_header_ranked AS (
 SELECT s.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY shipment_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_header_distinct s WHERE shipment_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
),
__actual_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT shipment_id,MIN(shipped_at) AS shipped_at,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_header_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY shipment_id
),
__actual_item_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS item_id,new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,new_seq::text AS seq_raw,new_product_id::text AS product_id,
 new_productcode::text AS product_code,new_uom_id::text AS uom_id,new_qty::numeric AS shipped_qty,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_item_source
),
__actual_item_ranked AS (
 SELECT i.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_item_distinct i WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
),
__actual_items AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT item_id,MIN(shipment_id) AS shipment_id,MIN(order_id) AS order_id,MIN(seq_raw) AS seq_raw,
 MIN(product_id) AS product_id,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,
 MIN(shipped_qty) AS shipped_qty,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_item_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY item_id
),
__actual_joined AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,s.shipment_id AS matched_header_id,s.shipped_at,s.statecode AS header_state,
 s.version_issue AS header_version_issue,
 CASE WHEN btrim(i.seq_raw) ~ '^[0-9]+([.]0+)?$' THEN btrim(i.seq_raw)::numeric END AS normalized_seq
 FROM __actual_items i JOIN __orders o ON o.salesorderid=i.order_id
 LEFT JOIN __actual_headers s ON s.shipment_id=i.shipment_id
),
__actual_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND header_state=0 AND shipped_at<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
),
__actual_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.item_id,COUNT(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_matches,
 MIN(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_id,MIN(l.uom_id) AS line_uom_id
 FROM __actual_eligible i LEFT JOIN __line_latest l ON l.salesorderid=i.order_id
 AND l.lineitemnumber::numeric=i.normalized_seq
 AND (l.new_product_id=i.product_id OR NULLIF(btrim(i.product_code),'')=NULLIF(btrim(l.product_code),''))
 GROUP BY i.item_id
),
__actual_linked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,m.line_matches,m.line_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'')=NULLIF(btrim(m.line_uom_id),''),FALSE) AS same_uom
 FROM __actual_eligible i JOIN __actual_matches m ON m.item_id=i.item_id
),
__actual_problem_rows AS (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 WHEN line_matches<>1 THEN '发货明细无法唯一关联订单行'
 WHEN NOT same_uom THEN '发货与订单计量单位不一致或缺失'
 WHEN shipped_qty IS NULL THEN '实际发货数量缺失' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_linked
 WHERE version_issue OR header_version_issue OR line_matches<>1 OR NOT same_uom OR shipped_qty IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN matched_header_id IS NULL THEN '发货明细找不到可用发货主表'
 WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 ELSE '有效发货单缺实际发货时间' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND
 (matched_header_id IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR (header_state=0 AND shipped_at IS NULL))
),
__actual_bad_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,string_agg(DISTINCT reason,'、' ORDER BY reason) AS reason
 FROM __actual_problem_rows GROUP BY order_id
),
__actual_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,SUM(shipped_qty) AS net_shipped_qty,
 BOOL_OR(shipped_qty IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR NOT same_uom) AS source_issue
 FROM __actual_linked WHERE line_matches=1 GROUP BY line_id
),
__line_balances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.quantity AS ordered_qty,
 COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0) AS net_shipped_qty,b.reason AS actual_problem,
 l.source_issue OR COALESCE(s.source_issue,FALSE) OR b.order_id IS NOT NULL
 OR l.quantity IS NULL OR l.quantity<0 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)<0
 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)>l.quantity AS quantity_issue
 FROM __active_lines l LEFT JOIN __actual_by_line s ON s.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __actual_bad_orders b ON b.order_id=l.salesorderid
),
__pending_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty END AS pending_qty,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE net_shipped_qty END AS net_shipped_qty,
 quantity_issue,actual_problem,FALSE AS energy_product_issue,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue OR ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty>0 THEN 1::bigint END AS plan_rows
 FROM __line_balances
),
__product_raw AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT DISTINCT p.productid::text AS productid,

 CASE WHEN p.new_system_energy>0 THEN p.new_system_energy::numeric

      WHEN p.new_voltage>0 AND p.new_capacity>0 THEN p.new_voltage::numeric*p.new_capacity::numeric/1000::numeric

 END AS unit_energy_kwh

 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" p

 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __active_lines l WHERE l.new_product_id=p.productid::text)

), __product_energy AS (

 SELECT productid,MIN(unit_energy_kwh) AS unit_energy_kwh,

 COUNT(*)>1 OR BOOL_OR(unit_energy_kwh IS NULL OR unit_energy_kwh<=0) AS source_issue

 FROM __product_raw GROUP BY productid

),

__opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
 WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_risklevel::text AS risk_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
),
__accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name,
 MIN(a.new_accountlevel)::text AS customer_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')
),
__team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.teamid::text AS team_id,t.name::text AS team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid
),
__owner_teams AS (
 SELECT owner_id,string_agg(DISTINCT team_name,'、' ORDER BY team_name) AS team_names FROM __team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
__line_base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.salesorderid AS order_id,l.new_product_id AS product_id,
 l.quantity AS ordered_qty,l.requestdeliveryby AS due_at,l.requestdeliveryby::date AS due_date,l.source_issue AS line_issue,
 so.order_no,so.customerid,so.order_amount,so.source_issue AS order_issue,ot.total_quantity,ot.quantity_issue AS order_quantity_issue,
 o.d002,o.d003,a.customer_level AS d005,COALESCE(o.owner_id,so.ownerid) AS owner_id,so.customer_name AS d006,CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.d005 IN ('0','1','2') OR o.risk_level IN ('1','2'),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,p.pending_qty,p.net_shipped_qty,p.actual_problem,p.quantity_issue AS pending_quantity_issue,p.plan_rows,pr.unit_energy_kwh,(pr.productid IS NULL OR pr.source_issue) AS product_issue
 FROM __active_lines l JOIN __orders so ON so.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 JOIN __order_totals ot ON ot.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __pending_by_line p ON p.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __product_energy pr ON pr.productid=l.new_product_id
 LEFT JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.new_opportunity_id),''),ot.unique_opportunityid,NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid),''))
 LEFT JOIN __accounts a ON a.customer_name=so.customer_name
),
__line_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,team.team_names AS d004,
 CASE WHEN due_at<(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN due_at>=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) THEN 'normal_pending' END AS status_code,
 (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-due_date AS overdue_days,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND order_amount IS NOT NULL AND ordered_qty>=0 AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*ordered_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS allocated_order_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND pending_qty>0 AND ordered_qty>0 AND pending_qty<=ordered_qty AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*pending_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS pending_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND NOT product_issue
 AND pending_qty>0 AND (ordered_qty IS NULL OR pending_qty<=ordered_qty)
 THEN pending_qty*unit_energy_kwh END AS pending_energy_kwh
 FROM __line_base f LEFT JOIN __owner_teams team ON team.owner_id=f.owner_id
),
__line_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.* FROM __line_facts f WHERE TRUE
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D002) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D002)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D003) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D003)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __team_members tm WHERE tm.owner_id=f.owner_id AND (tm.team_name IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR tm.team_id IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004)))))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR CASE f.d005 WHEN '0' THEN '核心大客户' WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR f.customerid IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D045) OR (f.anomaly_flag IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D045)))
),
__pending_scope AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT f.* FROM __line_scope f WHERE f.plan_rows IS NOT NULL

 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pending_filter)

      OR f.status_code IS NULL OR f.status_code IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pending_filter))

 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pie_filter)

      OR CASE f.status_code WHEN 'overdue_pending' THEN '超期订未发' WHEN 'normal_pending' THEN '正常订未发' END

         IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pie_filter))

),

__totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code IS NULL) AS missing_due_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS overdue_amount_valid_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS normal_amount_valid_rows,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_amount,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_amount,
 SUM(pending_energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_energy
 FROM __pending_scope
),
__denominator AS (
 SELECT SUM(allocated_order_amount) FILTER(WHERE allocated_order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND (plan_rows IS NULL OR (pending_amount IS NOT NULL AND status_code IS NOT NULL))) AS order_amount
 FROM __line_scope
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.overdue_energy/1000000::numeric END AS "M0134"
FROM __totals t CROSS JOIN __denominator d
