S13.name: 发货办理订单电量
S13.definition: 按发货办理状态（逾期未完成 / 临期未完成 / 正常未完成 / 逾期完成 / 正常完成）统计的订单电量。
S13.rule: 逾期未完成或逾期完成电量 > 0 判定发货办理逾期（BR-C08）。
S13.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
           max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
    FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
    WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL' AND config_group='HELMET'
      AND dimension_code='YWLN_D024' AND enabled
), cancelled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT new_salesorderid::text AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb"
    WHERE TRUE AND salesorderid<>new_salesorderid
      AND TRUE AND new_changestatus::text='8'
      AND new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
), order_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS fact_id,
           so.new_approval_time::timestamp AS started_at,
           o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
           CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
                ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
           COALESCE(o.ownerid,so.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,
           COALESCE(c.new_accountlevel::text,o.new_accountlevel::text) AS d005,
           NULLIF(btrim(c.name::text),'') AS d006
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" c ON c.accountid=so.customerid
    WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.new_salesordertype::text='1'
      AND so.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3') AND so.statecode=0
      AND so.new_ord_oa_state::text='5'
      AND NOT COALESCE(TRUE AND so.new_changestatus::text='8'
                       AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters),FALSE)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cancelled_orders x WHERE x.order_id=so.salesorderid::text)
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS id_copies FROM order_distinct
), line_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderid::text AS order_id,l.salesorderdetailid::text AS line_id,
           l.new_dischargecapacity::numeric AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
    WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=l.salesorderid::text)
      AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
      AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
), lines_checked AS (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id,line_id) AS copies FROM line_distinct
), line_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR energy_kwh IS NULL) THEN NULL
                        ELSE sum(energy_kwh) END AS energy_kwh
    FROM lines_checked GROUP BY order_id
), first_shipment AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,min(s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS finished_at
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
    WHERE s.statecode=0 AND TRUE AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
    GROUP BY s.new_salesorderid::text
), source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT o.*,l.energy_kwh,s.finished_at FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN line_totals l ON l.order_id=o.fact_id
    LEFT JOIN first_shipment s ON s.order_id=o.fact_id
), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.*,CASE
        WHEN f.id_copies=1 AND f.started_at IS NOT NULL AND f.started_at<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
         AND (f.finished_at IS NULL OR (f.finished_at>=f.started_at AND f.finished_at<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)))
         AND p.cycle_target_days>=0 AND p.imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND p.cycle_target_days
        THEN CASE
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-f.started_at::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
                THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-f.started_at::date)>p.imminent_days
                THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_completed'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date<=p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'normal_completed'
        END END AS status_code
    FROM source_rows f CROSS JOIN parameters p
), scoped AS (
    SELECT f.* FROM classified f WHERE f.status_code IS NOT NULL
     AND f.started_at>=CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp) AND f.started_at<CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 
)
SELECT f.status_code AS "YWLN_D024",sum(f.energy_kwh)/1000000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0312"
FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.status_code

C01.name: 商机获取金额
C01.definition: 有效商机月度预测金额汇总（看板商机获取口径）。
C01.rule: 已签单商机占比的分母（C10）。
C01.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH fact_distinct AS (
    SELECT
      m."new_oppmonthid" AS fact_id,
      CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST((
        m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
      ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_value,
      CASE
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP)) < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
        THEN m.new_forecast_amt_rmb
        ELSE m."new_forecast_amt_rmb"
      END AS amount_value,
      (
        (
          m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
        ) IS NULL
      ) AS energy_missing,
      CAST(o."new_salesbg" AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o."new_accproducttype" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT)) = ''
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      o."ownerid" AS owner_id,
      CAST(o."new_accountlevel" AS TEXT) AS d005,
      (
        SELECT
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '')
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        WHERE
          CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(o."parentaccountid" AS TEXT)
      ) AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
          WHERE
            __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
        )
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS d015,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND o."opportunityid" IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
            AND (
              CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM (
          SELECT
            dimension_code,
            cycle_target_days,
            imminent_days,
            (
              cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
              AND cycle_target_days >= 0
              AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
              AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
            ) AS enabled
          FROM (
            SELECT
              dimension_code,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
            FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
            WHERE
              config_set = 'MOCK'
              AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
              AND config_group = 'HELMET'
              AND enabled
            GROUP BY
              dimension_code
          ) AS v
        ) AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS d020
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_whprice"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_whprice",
          1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              ))
              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
            )
          )
      ) AS __latest
      WHERE
        __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
    ) AS m
    JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
      ON o."opportunityid" = m."new_opportunity_id"
    WHERE
      CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  ), fact_versions AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS fact_copies
    FROM fact_distinct
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
    FROM fact_versions AS f
    WHERE
      1 = 1
      AND (
        (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
          f.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            CAST((
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) AS TIMESTAMP)
          )
          AND f.fact_date < CAST((
            SELECT
              end_at
            FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    SUM(f.energy_value) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0022",
    SUM(f.amount_value) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
  FROM scoped AS f
) AS __x360_period_result
/*X360_ONTOLOGY_FORECAST_ALIGN_20261114*/

C02.name: 商机获取电量
C02.definition: 有效商机月度预测电量汇总（看板商机获取口径）。
C02.rule: 商机覆盖的电量侧证据。
C02.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH fact_distinct AS (
    SELECT
      m."new_oppmonthid" AS fact_id,
      CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST((
        m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
      ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_value,
      CASE
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP)) < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
        THEN m.new_forecast_amt_rmb
        ELSE m."new_forecast_amt_rmb"
      END AS amount_value,
      (
        (
          m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
        ) IS NULL
      ) AS energy_missing,
      CAST(o."new_salesbg" AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o."new_accproducttype" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT)) = ''
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      o."ownerid" AS owner_id,
      CAST(o."new_accountlevel" AS TEXT) AS d005,
      (
        SELECT
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '')
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        WHERE
          CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(o."parentaccountid" AS TEXT)
      ) AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
          WHERE
            __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
        )
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS d015,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND o."opportunityid" IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
            AND (
              CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM (
          SELECT
            dimension_code,
            cycle_target_days,
            imminent_days,
            (
              cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
              AND cycle_target_days >= 0
              AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
              AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
            ) AS enabled
          FROM (
            SELECT
              dimension_code,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
            FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
            WHERE
              config_set = 'MOCK'
              AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
              AND config_group = 'HELMET'
              AND enabled
            GROUP BY
              dimension_code
          ) AS v
        ) AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS d020
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_whprice"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_whprice",
          1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              ))
              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
            )
          )
      ) AS __latest
      WHERE
        __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
    ) AS m
    JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
      ON o."opportunityid" = m."new_opportunity_id"
    WHERE
      CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  ), fact_versions AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS fact_copies
    FROM fact_distinct
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
    FROM fact_versions AS f
    WHERE
      1 = 1
      AND (
        (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
          f.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            CAST((
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) AS TIMESTAMP)
          )
          AND f.fact_date < CAST((
            SELECT
              end_at
            FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    SUM(f.energy_value) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0022",
    SUM(f.amount_value) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
  FROM scoped AS f
) AS __x360_period_result

C03.rule: > 0 判定上游商机覆盖不足（BR-C01），联动商机获取卡片 RK01。
C03.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_risk_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        original.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
            CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
          ), original.new_year
          ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __customer_target_rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
  )
  SELECT
    customer_target_result.*
  FROM (
    WITH __x360_gov_source_7 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw."new_targetid",
        __x360_raw."ownerid",
        __x360_raw."createdon",
        __x360_raw."statecode",
        __x360_raw."new_month1",
        __x360_raw."new_month10",
        __x360_raw."new_month11",
        __x360_raw."new_month12",
        __x360_raw."new_month2",
        __x360_raw."new_month3",
        __x360_raw."new_month4",
        __x360_raw."new_month5",
        __x360_raw."new_month6",
        __x360_raw."new_month7",
        __x360_raw."new_month8",
        __x360_raw."new_month9",
        __x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",
        __x360_raw."new_year",
        __x360_raw."new_target_type",
        CAST(__x360_product_type."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) AS "new_accproducttype"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_rank.*
        FROM (
          SELECT
            __x360_base.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
                CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
              ), __x360_base.new_year
              ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
            ) AS version_rn
          FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
        ) AS __x360_rank
        WHERE
          __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
      ) AS __x360_raw
      LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS __x360_product_type
        ON __x360_product_type."new_product_typeid" = __x360_raw."new_producttype_id"
    )
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      WITH common_period AS (
        SELECT
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
        WHERE
          FALSE
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          start_at,
          end_at
        FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
      ), gap_result AS (
        WITH selected_period AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            start_at,
            end_at
          FROM common_period
        ), forecast_distinct AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            m.new_oppmonthid,
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP),
            m.__ont_energy_mwh,
            m.new_year,
            m.new_month,
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan
          FROM (
            SELECT
              __latest."new_accountdate",
              __latest.__ont_energy_mwh,
              __latest."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
              __latest."new_month",
              __latest."new_oppmonthid",
              __latest."new_opportunity_id",
              __latest."new_year"
            FROM (
              SELECT
                __raw."createdon",
                __raw."modifiedon",
                __raw."new_accountdate",
                __raw.__ont_energy_mwh,
                __raw."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
                __raw."new_month",
                __raw."new_oppmonthid",
                __raw."new_opportunity_id",
                __raw."new_year",

                  OR (

                    )
                    AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                      SELECT
                        end_at
                      FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
                    )
                  )
                )
            ) AS __latest
            WHERE
              __latest.__x360_risk_period_latest_rn = 1
          ) AS m
          WHERE
            TRUE
            AND m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
              WHERE
                o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
            )
        ), forecast_unique AS (
          SELECT
            *,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY new_oppmonthid) AS id_copies

        ), forecast_scope AS (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM forecast_unique

              ) IS NULL

                  start_at

              )
            )

              (

                FROM selected_period

              OR CAST(new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (

            )
        ), forecast_agg AS (

            SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
              TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE AND amount_yuan IS NOT NULL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
          FROM forecast_scope
        ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            o.opportunityid,
            CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP)
          FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
          WHERE
            TRUE AND TRUE AND o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND TRUE
        ), opportunity_unique AS (
          SELECT
            *,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunityid) AS id_copies
          FROM opportunity_distinct
        ), opportunity_scope AS (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM opportunity_unique
          WHERE

            )
            AND (
              (

              ) IS NULL OR TRUE
            )
        ), opportunity_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,
            CASE WHEN BOOL_OR(id_copies > 1) THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT opportunityid) END AS "YWLN_M0024"
          FROM opportunity_scope
        ), source_rows AS (
          SELECT
            t.*,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY new_targetid) AS id_count
          FROM __x360_gov_source_7 AS t
          /* 当前接入范围：类型1销售目标、系统有效状态0。 */
          /* 类型4及客户开发目标不自动纳入，后续确认后再扩展。 */
          WHERE

        ), monthly AS (
          SELECT
            t.new_targetid,
            t.id_count,

              WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 AND t.new_year <> 0
              THEN MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1)
            END AS target_month,
            v.amount_yuan
          FROM source_rows AS t
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

              (1, t.new_month1),
              (2, t.new_month2),
              (3, t.new_month3),
              (4, t.new_month4),
              (5, t.new_month5),
              (6, t.new_month6),
              (7, t.new_month7),
              (8, t.new_month8),
              (9, t.new_month9),
              (10, t.new_month10),
              (11, t.new_month11),
              (12, t.new_month12)
          ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
        ), scoped AS (
          SELECT

            target_month IS NOT NULL
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR target_month >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              )))
            )
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR target_month < CASE
                WHEN (
                  SELECT
                    end_at
                  FROM selected_period
                ) IS NOT NULL
                THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', (
                  SELECT
                    start_at
                  FROM selected_period
                )) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
              END
            )
        ), target_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,
            SUM(amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0002"
          FROM scoped
        ), buckets AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket
        )
        SELECT
          t."YWLN_M0002" - f."YWLN_M0023" AS "YWLN_M0140"
        FROM buckets AS b

      ), customer_result AS (

C04.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_gov_source_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    __x360_raw."project_name",
    __x360_raw."input_time",
    __x360_raw."energy_mwh",
    __x360_raw."is_awarded",
    __x360_raw."winner_announce_time",
    __x360_raw."remark",
    __x360_raw."seq_no" AS "bid_record_id",
    __x360_raw."bid_amount" AS "bid_amount"
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_bid_project_info" AS __x360_raw
)
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  WITH __signed_order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        sx.opportunityid || ''
      ) AS opportunityid,
      (
        sx.salesorderid || ''
      ) AS salesorderid,
      (
        sx.new_salesorderid || ''
      ) AS new_salesorderid,
      sx.statecode,
      sx.new_changetype,
      sx.new_changestatus,
      sx.new_approval_time
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS sx
  ), __signed_keys_0 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid
    FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
  ), shared_bounds AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __ont_bounds
  )
  SELECT
    (
      WITH requested AS (
        SELECT
          start_at,
          end_at
        FROM shared_bounds
      ), bounds AS (
        SELECT
          MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
          MAX(end_at) AS end_at
        FROM requested
      ), measure_rows AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
          CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
          CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          CAST((
            f.amount_yuan
          ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
          (
            COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR (
              f.amount_yuan
            ) IS NULL
          ) AS invalid,
          (
            FALSE
          ) AS poison_time,
          f.d002,
          f.d003,
          f.owner_id,
          f.d005,
          f.d006,
          f.status_code,
          f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
        FROM (
          WITH opportunity_link_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT
              CAST(name AS TEXT) AS linked_project_name,
              COUNT(DISTINCT opportunityid) AS matches,
              MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunity_id
            FROM __ont_opportunity
            WHERE
              opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY
              CAST(name AS TEXT)
          ), ranked AS (
            SELECT
              b.*,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY project_name
                ORDER BY CAST(input_time AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, bid_record_id DESC
              ) AS rn
            FROM __x360_gov_source_1 AS b
            WHERE
              project_name IS NOT NULL
              AND project_name ~ '[^[:space:]]'
              AND bid_record_id IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(input_time AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(input_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
          ), linked AS (
            SELECT
              b.*,
              COALESCE(mx.matches, 0) AS matches,
              mx.opportunity_id
            FROM ranked AS b
            LEFT JOIN opportunity_link_summary AS mx
              ON mx.linked_project_name = CAST(b.project_name AS TEXT)
            WHERE
              b.rn = 1
          )
          SELECT DISTINCT
            CAST(b.bid_record_id AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
            CAST(b.input_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
            CAST(b.input_time AS TIMESTAMP),
            CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP),
            b.energy_mwh,
            CASE
              WHEN (
                (
                  TO_JSONB(b."bid_amount") #>> '{}'
                )
              ) ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN CAST((
                (
                  TO_JSONB(b."bid_amount") #>> '{}'
                )
              ) AS DECIMAL)
            END AS amount_yuan,
            CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
            CASE
              WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
              THEN NULL
              WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
              THEN '其他'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
              THEN '电芯'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
              THEN 'PACK'
              ELSE '其他'
            END AS d003,
            CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status_code,
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
            FALSE AS source_issue,
            b.matches AS opportunity_matches,
            COALESCE(o.opportunityid IN (
              SELECT
                opportunityid
              FROM __signed_keys_0
            ), FALSE) AS has_signed,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') LIKE '%弃标%'
            ) AS abandoned,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
              AND CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
              AND b.is_awarded IN ('是', '1')
            ) AS won,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
              AND CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
              AND b.is_awarded IN ('否', '0')
            ) AS lost,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
              AND (
                CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
                OR CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) > (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
              )
            ) AS in_progress
          FROM linked AS b
          LEFT JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
            LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
              ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
            ON o.opportunityid = b.opportunity_id AND b.matches = 1
        ) AS f
        WHERE
          f.won AND NOT f.has_signed
      ), checked AS (
        SELECT
          *,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
        FROM measure_rows
      ), scoped AS (
        SELECT
          f.*,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
        FROM checked AS f
        WHERE
          (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              f.fact_date >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM bounds
              )
              AND f.fact_date < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM bounds
              )
            )
            OR f.poison_time
          )
      )
      SELECT
        (
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM scoped AS x
              WHERE
                x.measure_tag = 'm0' AND x.poison_time
            )
            OR COALESCE(
              BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
                f.measure_tag = 'm0'),
              FALSE
            )
            THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
              f.measure_tag = 'm0')
          END
        ) AS "YWLN_M0179"
      FROM scoped AS f
      GROUP BY
        ()
    ) AS "YWLN_M0179",
    (
      WITH requested AS (
        SELECT
          start_at,
          end_at
        FROM shared_bounds
      ), bounds AS (
        SELECT
          MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
          MAX(end_at) AS end_at
        FROM requested
      ), measure_rows AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
          CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
          CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          CAST((
            f.amount_yuan
          ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
          (
            COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE)
            OR COALESCE((
              FALSE
            ), FALSE)
            OR (
              f.amount_yuan
            ) IS NULL
          ) AS invalid,
          (
            FALSE
          ) AS poison_time,
          f.d002,
          f.d003,
          f.owner_id,
          f.d005,
          f.d006,
          f.status_code,
          f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
        FROM (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
            CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
            CASE
              WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
              THEN NULL
              WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
              THEN '其他'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
              THEN '电芯'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
              THEN 'PACK'
              ELSE '其他'
            END AS d003,
            CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
            CASE
              WHEN COALESCE(o.opportunityid IN (
                SELECT
                  opportunityid
                FROM __signed_keys_0
              ), FALSE)
              THEN 'signed_opportunity'
              ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
            END AS status_code,
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
            (
              CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
              OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
            ) AS is_key,
            CAST((
              m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
            ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
            TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
            FALSE AS source_issue
          FROM __ont_forecast AS m
          JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
            LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
              ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
            ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
          WHERE
            m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND TRUE
            AND TRUE
            AND TRUE
            AND TRUE
        ) AS f
        WHERE
          f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND TRUE AND f.amount_yuan IS NOT NULL
      ), checked AS (
        SELECT
          *,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
        FROM measure_rows
      ), scoped AS (
        SELECT
          f.*,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
        FROM checked AS f
        WHERE
          (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at

-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __signed_order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      sx.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid,
    (
      sx.salesorderid || ''
    ) AS salesorderid,
    (
      sx.new_salesorderid || ''
    ) AS new_salesorderid,
    sx.statecode,

    sx.new_changestatus,
    sx.new_approval_time
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS sx
), __signed_keys_0 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    (
      sign_stage.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid
  FROM __ont_opportunity AS sign_stage
  WHERE
    sign_stage.new_contractconfirmation = 1
), shared_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
)
SELECT
  (
    WITH requested AS (
      SELECT
        start_at,
        end_at
      FROM shared_bounds
    ), bounds AS (
      SELECT
        MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
        MAX(end_at) AS end_at
      FROM requested
    ), measure_rows AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
        CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
        CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST((
          f.energy_mwh
        ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
        (
          COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
            FALSE
          ), FALSE)
        ) AS invalid,
        (
          FALSE
        ) AS poison_time,
        f.d002,
        f.d003,
        f.owner_id,
        f.d005,
        f.d006,
        f.status_code,
        f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
          CASE
            WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END AS d003,
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
              WHERE
                __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
            )
            THEN 'signed_opportunity'
            ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
          END AS status_code,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
          (
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
            OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
          ) AS is_key,
          CAST((
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
          ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
          m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
          TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
          FALSE AS source_issue
        FROM __ont_forecast AS m
        JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
          LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
            ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
          ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
        WHERE
          m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      ) AS f
      WHERE
        f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND f.energy_mwh IS NOT NULL
    ), checked AS (
      SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
      FROM measure_rows
    ), scoped AS (
      SELECT
        f.*,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
      FROM checked AS f
      WHERE
        (
          (
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM bounds
          ) IS NULL
          OR (
            f.fact_date >= (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM bounds
            )
            AND f.fact_date < (
              SELECT
                end_at
              FROM bounds
            )
          )
          OR f.poison_time
        )
    )
    SELECT
      (
        SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
          f.measure_tag = 'm0')
      ) AS "YWLN_M0194"
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      ()
  ) AS "YWLN_M0194",
  (
    WITH requested AS (
      SELECT
        start_at,
        end_at
      FROM shared_bounds
    ), bounds AS (
      SELECT
        MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
        MAX(end_at) AS end_at
      FROM requested
    ), measure_rows AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
        CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
        CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST((
          f.amount_yuan
        ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
        (
          COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
            FALSE
          ), FALSE)
        ) AS invalid,
        (
          FALSE
        ) AS poison_time,
        f.d002,
        f.d003,
        f.owner_id,
        f.d005,
        f.d006,
        f.status_code,
        f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
          CASE
            WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END AS d003,
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
              WHERE
                __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
            )
            THEN 'signed_opportunity'
            ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
          END AS status_code,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
          (
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
            OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
          ) AS is_key,
          CAST((
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
          ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
          m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
          TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
          FALSE AS source_issue
        FROM __ont_forecast AS m
        JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
          LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
            ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
          ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
        WHERE
          m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      ) AS f
      WHERE
        f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND TRUE AND f.amount_yuan IS NOT NULL
    ), checked AS (
      SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
      FROM measure_rows
    ), scoped AS (
      SELECT
        f.*,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
      FROM checked AS f
      WHERE
        (
          (
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM bounds
          ) IS NULL
          OR (
            f.fact_date >= (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM bounds
            )
            AND f.fact_date < (
              SELECT
                end_at
              FROM bounds
            )
          )
          OR f.poison_time
        )
    )
    SELECT
      (
        SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
          f.measure_tag = 'm0')
      ) AS "YWLN_M0198"
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY

  ) AS "YWLN_M0198"

WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (

          __x360_rank.*
        FROM (
          SELECT
            __x360_base.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
                CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
              ), __x360_base.new_year
              ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
            ) AS version_rn
          FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
        ) AS __x360_rank
        WHERE
          __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
      ) AS __x360_raw
      LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS __x360_product_type
        ON __x360_product_type."new_product_typeid" = __x360_raw."new_producttype_id"
    )
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      WITH common_period AS (
        SELECT

          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
        WHERE
          FALSE
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          start_at,

        FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
      ), gap_result AS (
        WITH selected_period AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            start_at,
            end_at
          FROM common_period
        ), forecast_distinct AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            m.new_oppmonthid,
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP),
            m.__ont_energy_mwh,
            m.new_year,
            m.new_month,

          FROM (

              __latest."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
              __latest."new_month",
              __latest."new_oppmonthid",

            FROM (

                __raw."modifiedon",
                __raw."new_accountdate",
                __raw.__ont_energy_mwh,
                __raw."new_forecast_amt_rmb",

                __raw."new_oppmonthid",
                __raw."new_opportunity_id",
                __raw."new_year",
                1 AS __x360_risk_period_latest_rn
              FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
              WHERE
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
                AND (

                  OR (

                    AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (

                      FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
                    )
                  )
                )
            ) AS __latest
            WHERE
              __latest.__x360_risk_period_latest_rn = 1
          ) AS m
          WHERE
            TRUE
            AND m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
              WHERE
                o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
            )
        ), forecast_unique AS (
          SELECT
            *,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY new_oppmonthid) AS id_copies
          FROM forecast_distinct
        ), forecast_scope AS (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM forecast_unique
          WHERE
            (
              (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR CAST(new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              )
            )
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR CAST(new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              )
            )
        ), forecast_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,
            SUM(__ont_energy_mwh) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0022",
            SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
              TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE AND amount_yuan IS NOT NULL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
          FROM forecast_scope
        ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            o.opportunityid,
            CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP)
          FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
          WHERE
            TRUE AND TRUE AND o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND TRUE
        ), opportunity_unique AS (
          SELECT
            *,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunityid) AS id_copies
          FROM opportunity_distinct
        ), opportunity_scope AS (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM opportunity_unique

                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL OR TRUE
            )
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period

        ), opportunity_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,

          FROM opportunity_scope
        ), source_rows AS (

          /* 当前接入范围：类型1销售目标、系统有效状态0。 */

          WHERE

              (8, t.new_month8),
              (9, t.new_month9),
              (10, t.new_month10),
              (11, t.new_month11),
              (12, t.new_month12)

        ), scoped AS (

                SELECT

                FROM selected_period

                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period

            )
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR target_month < CASE
                WHEN (
                  SELECT
                    end_at
                  FROM selected_period
                ) IS NOT NULL
                THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', (
                  SELECT
                    start_at
                  FROM selected_period
                )) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
              END
            )
        ), target_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,
            SUM(amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0002"
          FROM scoped
        ), buckets AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket
        )
        SELECT
          t."YWLN_M0002" - f."YWLN_M0023" AS "YWLN_M0140"
        FROM buckets AS b
        LEFT JOIN forecast_agg AS f
          ON f.bucket = b.bucket
        LEFT JOIN target_agg AS t
          ON t.bucket = b.bucket
      ), customer_result AS (
/*X360_R09_ONTOLOGY_ALIGN_20261114*/

), __x360_r09_accounts AS MATERIALIZED (

), __x360_r09_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (

 WHERE a.new_accountlevel::text='1' AND o.opportunityid IS NULL
), scoped AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.fact_id) AS "YWLN_M0257" FROM scoped f
)
      SELECT
        g."YWLN_M0140",
        c."YWLN_M0257"
      FROM gap_result AS g

    ) AS __x360_gov_result
  ) AS customer_target_result
) AS __x360_risk_period_result /* X360_RISK_FIX_20261109 */ /* X360_ONTOLOGY_FORECAST_ALIGN_20261114 */

ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

IS01.name: 销售额与出货量双双落后时间进度
IS01.description: 销售额达成率与出货量达成率同时低于年度时间进度
IS01.condition: R01 < B05 且 R02 < B05（均为 0～1 小数；任一侧缺值不判定）
IS01.levelRule: 两项中落后较多者 ≥ 15 个百分点 极高；10～15 高；< 10 中（沿用商机获取节点 BR-A02 落后分档）

IS02.name: 全年预计达成缺口
IS02.description: 按已发生实绩＋后续预测推算，全年销售额或出货量预计不达成
IS02.condition: R05 < 1 或 R07 < 1（金额、电量分别判断）
IS02.levelRule: 预计达成率 < 0.9 高；0.9～1 中（建议值·待业务确认）
IS02.objects: 产品团队、产品类型、客户

IS03.name: 销售额与出货量量价背离
IS03.description: 销售额与出货量进度差异明显，金额与电量未同步
IS03.condition: |R03| ≥ 10 个百分点（建议值·待业务确认）
IS03.levelRule: |R03| ≥ 20 个百分点 高；10～20 中（建议值·待业务确认）
IS03.source: 共同分析新增（销售额 × 出货量交叉）

IS04.name: 超期订未发积压
IS04.description: 承诺交期已过的订单仍未发货，占订未发比例偏高
IS04.condition: S05 > 0 且 S08 ≥ 0.2（建议值·待业务确认）
IS04.source: 看板 M0143 / M0134 / 超期订未发占比

IS05.name: 在手订单不足以覆盖剩余目标
IS05.description: 订未发金额 / 电量不足以支撑年度剩余目标

IS05.levelRule: C09 < 0.5 高；0.5～1 中（建议值·待业务确认）
IS05.source: 共同分析新增（订单储备 × 剩余目标）

IS06.name: 订单履约率偏低
IS06.description: 已签订单截至期末的发货履约不足

IS07.levelRule: 战略大客户存在缺口 高；仅重要大客户存在缺口 中

IS08.name: 订单取消／变更冲减

BR-Q01.name: 销售额实绩口径
BR-Q01.description: 发货明细 new_amount_base 汇总 ÷ 10^8（亿元）；按发货单 new_shipping2_date 归期；仅 new_qty > 0 的发货行
BR-Q01.result: 金额为空不补 0；SUM 忽略单个 NULL

BR-Q02.name: 出货量实绩口径
BR-Q02.description: 已发货数量 × 产品物料单套电量（kWh）÷ 10^6（GWh）；按发货日期归期
BR-Q02.result: 缺产品电量的发货行不计入电量并在明细披露

BR-Q03.name: 目标去重口径
BR-Q03.description: 销售目标先按 COALESCE(商机 ID, 目标 ID)＋年度按 createdon DESC、new_targetid DESC 取 rn = 1，再展开 12 个月汇总；金额 ÷ 10^8，电量 new_month*_power 按 kWh ÷ 10^6（同商机获取节点 BR-Q03 / BR-Q11）
BR-Q03.result: 客户、产品、团队仅为汇总维度，不作去重键

BR-Q04.name: 有效订单口径
BR-Q04.description: 订单按 OA 审批时间归期；有效订单行沿用看板 M0032 口径；订单状态分正常订单 / 订单变更 / 订单取消（D016）
BR-Q04.result: 取消订单在履约率分子分母两侧同时排除

BR-Q05.name: 订未发与超期判定
BR-Q05.description: 承诺发货日 = 订单产品 requestdeliveryby（同一订单多行取最早）；早于统计截止日仍未发货为超期订未发，否则为正常订未发
BR-Q05.result: 金额字段缺失或来源有歧义时返回空值，不补 0

BR-Q06.name: 时间进度口径
BR-Q06.description: 年度时间消耗 = 统计截止日已过天数 ÷ 全年天数
BR-Q06.result: 统计截止日为所选期末与观察日较早者

BR-Q07.name: 共同分析同期间约束
BR-Q07.description: 跨环节（商机 / 订单 / 发货）证据必须同一统计期间、同一默认筛选范围；至少两个环节有证据才输出共同分析
BR-Q07.result: 期间不一致的证据不合并；缺失环节在结果中披露

BR-Q08.name: 跨环节不混算
BR-Q08.description: 不同业务状态（预测 / 订单 / 发货）只做关联比较，不相加为同一指标
BR-Q08.result: 跨环节比较须注明各自口径与观察时间

BR-DQ01.name: 缺值不补零
BR-DQ01.description: 任一输入缺失时相应指标保持 NULL，不以 0 参与比较；问题规则输入缺失时交由模型判断或标注无法判定
BR-DQ01.result: 缺值条数在结果明细披露
